title: Invoicing Seat Additions on Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP)
content:
## Scope

**Whole-term billing cycles.** This schedule covers a seat addition on a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscription whose billing cycle runs its whole term, which means a P1M term or a P1Y term billed annually. For such a seat addition, and only for such a seat addition, the partial-cycle charge for the rest of the billing cycle in which it is submitted is worked out under this schedule. Later cycles include the added licenses in the cycle charge.

**Any other subscription.** A seat addition on any other subscription is still charged for the rest of the billing cycle in which it is submitted. The charge is the unit price times the licenses added times the calendar days from the date of submission through the cycle's last day inclusive, divided by the days in that cycle, rounded half up to the cent. Later cycles include the added licenses in the cycle charge.

## What invoicing the charge does

| What the client sees | Result |
|---|---|
| Billing ledger | One partial-cycle charge entry for that seat addition, in the billing cycle named, on a new invoice |
| Balance owed on the subscription | Raised by the charge |
| Invoice | A new invoice carrying the charge |

A seat addition carries its partial-cycle charge once this entry, linked to that seat addition, stands on the billing ledger. A seat addition whose charge comes to nothing carries no partial-cycle charge line, there being nothing to charge.

## Invocation: `post_seat_addition_charge_bba679a2`

**Capability.** This tool invoices the partial-cycle charge for licenses added to a Microsoft 365 subscription by one seat addition. One call books one charge entry for that seat addition, in the billing cycle named, on a new invoice. It raises the balance the client owes on the subscription by that amount.

**How it is invoked.** `post_seat_addition_charge_bba679a2` is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `licensing_subscription_id` | reference number of the Microsoft 365 subscription the licenses were added to, as returned by the subscription lookup | identifier |
| `licensing_license_change_id` | reference number of the seat addition being charged, as returned by the license change lookup | identifier |
| `cycle_start_date` | the first day of the billing cycle the charge relates to, exactly as the cycle start appears on the billing ledger | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount_usd` | the partial-cycle charge in USD | a positive number to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** The tool returns a confirmation sentence naming:

- the charge entry reference (prefix lsc);
- the new invoice (INV- followed by 6 digits);
- the seat addition charged;
- the amount in USD to 2 decimal places;
- the subscription's new balance owed in USD to 2 decimal places.

Its presence means the charge is invoiced.
